noTwoFactor.title: Turn on two-factor authentication
noTwoFactor.body: The admin console sees every customer, so it needs two-factor authentication on your account.

verify.title: Confirm it’s you
verify.body: This sign-in didn’t use your two-factor code. Sign in again with it to open the admin console.

notAdmin.title: Not available
notAdmin.body: Your account isn’t a platform admin any more.

publishing.title: Publishing
publishing.quiet: Nothing finished publishing in this period.

problems.title: Failed and stuck deliveries
problems.retryBody: It’s published again now, for {{workspace}}. A stuck delivery may already be on the network, so check first: it could appear twice.
problems.cancelBody: It won’t be sent to {{account}} ({{workspace}}). The post’s other accounts aren’t affected.

reason.label: Why
reason.placeholder: e.g. Network outage ended; customer asked us to resend
reason.hint_one: Kept in the audit log. {{count}} character (3 to 500).
reason.hint_other: Kept in the audit log. {{count}} characters (3 to 500).

queues.title: Queues
queues.body: Bull Board, read-only. To retry or cancel a delivery, use Publishing: it asks why and keeps it in the audit log.

accounts.title: Accounts needing attention
accounts.body: Accounts that stopped accepting posts, or whose sign-in runs out soon. Their owners are told; this shows how many scheduled posts are at risk across every workspace.
accounts.emptyBody_one: No account needs reconnecting or expires within {{count}} day.
accounts.emptyBody_other: No account needs reconnecting or expires within {{count}} days.
